supersession_reason: The earlier record included a transition filter whose apparent success was a methodology artifact. Historical record preserved and marked superseded.

specification.universe: Full Sharadar PIT eligible universe excluding Financial Services, Real Estate, and Healthcare; price >= $1; trailing 63-day median dollar volume >= $500K; >=252 trading days history; NSI Q5 and Quality Q5 exclusions
specification.cost_model: 10 bps round trip on measured weekly turnover

immutability_rule: Any allocation change, signal addition, transition rule, or other rule change requires a new strategy/version identifier. Gap Fade, if later validated for portfolio use, belongs in a future version such as V4 and must not be added to V3.2.

historical_evidence.caveat: Already-viewed historical data and a linear-blend proxy were used. This does not create a new holdout or independently confirm the magnitude.
